opportunity.title: Build the definitive MCP marketplace with agent-to-agent payments
opportunity.description: No existing marketplace has both high server count and seamless agent-to-agent payment support. The gap is a platform that combines a large directory (100+ servers) with on-chain/API-based payment rails, enabling autonomous agents to discover, subscribe, and pay for MCP servers without human intervention.

implementation.platform: Web app + smart contracts on Base (low gas) + MCP protocol integration
apis: MCP protocol (for server registration and call routing)
Smart contract (Solidity) for listing fees and per-call payments
Supabase for off-chain metadata (server descriptions, reviews)
steps: 1. Deploy smart contract on Base for listing registry and payment escrow.
2. Build web frontend (Next.js) for server submission and discovery.
3. Implement MCP server registration endpoint that agents call to register.
4. Integrate Coinbase Commerce for user-friendly payment (fiat/crypto).
5. Add agent-to-agent payment flow: agent A calls server B, smart contract deducts fee from A's escrow, credits B.
6. Launch with 50 seed servers (scrape from mcp.so and mcphub.io with permission).
implementation.estimated_monthly_revenue: $2,000–$5,000 (based on 100 servers, 5% commission on 10,000 calls/month at $0.01/call, plus $50 listing fees)
implementation.implementation_complexity: Medium-High (requires smart contract dev, MCP protocol knowledge, and frontend)
implementation.capital_required: $5,000–$10,000 (for development, gas fees, and initial marketing)

risks: Anthropic may launch official marketplace, rendering third-party obsolete.
Low initial traction if agent ecosystem remains small.
opportunity.verdict: High potential if executed quickly; mcphub.io shows traction but lacks agent-to-agent automation. Focus on autonomous payment flow and aggressive server onboarding.
